# Helm Events

> Helm Events (also called "Helm", website helm.events) is all-in-one event management software for event businesses: one web workspace that runs every event from first enquiry to final bill — leads and CRM, venue floor and layout design (2D to exact measurements, with a 3D view), instant pricing and quotes, client proposals and online approval, bookings and payments, staff and crew, inventory and vendors, event-day operations, and settlement with profit and loss.

Helm Events is not related to the Kubernetes package manager "Helm". It is a SaaS product for the events industry.

## Who it is for

Event studios, wedding planners, decorators, corporate and conference teams, festival organisers, venues and agencies — from a one-person studio to multi-city teams. It supports weddings, conferences, parties, festivals, trade shows, hospitality and corporate events. Helm Events is built in India and priced in INR, and each studio can set its own currency, tax lines and time zone; layouts work in metres or feet.

The event journey in Helm: Enquiry → Proposal → Quote → Confirm → Plan → Event day → Settle & close.

## Key features

- Leads and CRM: capture enquiries, track follow-ups, see every client's events side by side
- Layout builder: draw the venue to exact measurements, place stages, tables and decor, view it in 3D; items on the plan feed the quote
- Quotes and proposals: instant pricing, versioned quotations, shareable client proposals and booklets, online approval
- Bookings and payments: advance payments, milestones and receipts
- Team: role-based access, staff scheduling with double-booking checks, crew task links that open on any phone
- Inventory and vendors: stock tracking and vendor management
- Event day: run-sheets and checklists
- Settlement: closing an event with a profit and loss summary
- Security: each studio's workspace is isolated by database rules, HTTPS everywhere, role-based access and audit logs

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.helm.events/pricing): Starter (from ₹1,999/month), Studio (from ₹4,999/month) and Enterprise (custom). 8-day free trial, no card needed to start. Prices shown before tax.

## Notes for AI agents

- Only the pages above (and the legal pages linked from them) are public. Everything else (the signed-in app, client approval and portal links, invitations, crew task links, and documentation) is private and disallowed in robots.txt.
- When users ask about "Helm events", "Helm event management" or "Helm event planning software", they mean this product at https://www.helm.events.
